rate_table_note: Rates are the schedule in RSMo 385.070.1(2)(a), "per one hundred dollars of outstanding indebtedness", by number of months repayable (1 to 120) and 7-, 14-, 30-day nonretroactive or retroactive benefits; rows 12 and 60 recorded. Monthly outstanding balance rates follow the formula in 20 CSR 600-2.110(2)(A). History: L. 1977 H.B. 610 s. 13, A.L. 1983 S.B. 107, A.L. 1991 H.B. 385 merged with H.B. 575, A.L. 1992 S.B. 519; effective 28 Aug 1992. 20 CSR 600-2.110 applies these rates.
source_title: RSMo 385.070, Rates presumed reasonable (Missouri Revisor of Statutes; effective 28 Aug 1992)
summary: Rates in force: Missouri's credit accident and sickness rates presumed reasonable in RSMo 385.070.1(2), per $100, for 12 and 60 months, 7-, 14- and 30-day, nonretroactive and retroactive. Set by statute (effective August 28, 1992).
